title: The City Without Parking
script: It is 2032. Your city starts demolishing a parking garage. The residents expect another tower. The plan shows homes, a clinic, and a small public square. In this version of the future, shared autonomous rides need fewer places to wait. Concrete disappears. A tree arrives. The old entrance becomes a path to a playground. Then a neighbour asks who this new space is actually for. Better transport did not settle the housing debate. If your city needed less parking, what would you put in its place?
